_comment: ContextForge Plugin Registry. Each entry represents a supported game plugin. Plugins live in their own repos and register here so the core knows what's available.

plugins.name: Skyrim Special Edition
plugins.description: Bridges ContextForge to Skyrim SE via MinAI. Sends heartbeat state and combat/quest events to the ContextForge core server.
plugins.notes: First official plugin. Proof of concept target.

wanted.name: Baldur's Gate 3
wanted.notes: High community interest. Native scripting exposure makes this viable.

wanted.name: Elden Ring
wanted.notes: Memory-read approach likely required. Precedent exists in community tools.

wanted.name: Cyberpunk 2077
wanted.notes: CET (Cyber Engine Tweaks) provides solid scripting access.
